LanguageData.Gun_Orsis_T-5000_338_RWP.label: Orsis T-5000 .338
LanguageData.Gun_Orsis_T-5000_338_RWP.description: The Orsis T-5000 .338 is a high-precision sniper rifle designed for long-range accuracy. Manufactured with advanced materials and an ergonomic design, it excels in penetrating armor and delivering lethal shots from extended distances. Ideal for sharpshooters, this weapon is a formidable choice for neutralizing threats before they get close.
